_about: Tutorial pauses (systems/TutorialPause.js): the game freezes, everything darkens except the spotlight targets, a short text box appears and a tap continues. Each pause shows once per run (?pauses=0 turns them all off, ?pauses=all shows them every time). Only tutorial battles (battles.json tutorial: true) show them unless the pause says always: true.
_targetsAbout: cmd.<techniqueId> spotlights the slot that technique stands in while the technique list is open; enemy.poise.<n> is enemy n's poise line.

steps.text: This is your HP. Reach zero and the memory fades.
Echo. Strikes and PERFECT parries fill it.
Techniques spend Echo. Yours is still locked.

parry.text: Dov attacks! Tap anywhere when the ring closes on Rhea.

dodge.text: Or swipe to dodge: safer, but a dodge earns no Echo and no counter.

steps.text: Blast: your first Technique. 2 Echo, 2 bolts of pure memory.
Techniques spend the Echo your Strikes and PERFECT parries earn. When Echo runs out, Strike.
steps.textIfShort: Techniques spend the Echo your Strikes and PERFECT parries earn. When Echo runs out, Strike. (Strike once more to afford it.)

steps.text: The golden line is its footing. Every hit chips it.
Empty it and the enemy BREAKS: it loses its next turn and takes extra damage.
A RED ring can't be parried. Swipe anywhere to dodge it.
A PERFECT dodge takes nothing. Late takes half. A tap takes it all.
Recall grows: more HP, harder Strikes, and new techniques remembered.

crush.text: A heavy blow: only a PERFECT dodge avoids it fully. Swipe early!

steps.text: Nala lends her Echo: this round your Strikes can wound Hollows.
Tap her when she glows to call it again.
